reviews.text: Yesterday I had to put my dog ​​to sleep. They were very kind from the moment I called. The vet explained my three options very well and gave me plenty of time to be with her before and after the procedure. They also gave me a device to press each time I was ready for them to enter the room. I highly recommend them.

September 2026
Some reduced hours, but somehow no changes in price even when everything else is exponentially more expensive. It is good to see that the more administrative side of things is up to date now. Much rather prefer more limited hours and a maintained level of care vs reducing quality of care just to extend hours. It does mean needing to find another after hours location, but better to be focused on more limited hours than open but spread so thin it makes no difference.

December 2025
Communication has once again fallen some. Not sure what it is, but it sometimes feels everyone forgets that people do have schedules of their own, more importantly that an animal is sick and just waiting. There have been a few recent visits where the lack of communication wasted several hours, and recently a day that when one of my dogs potentially should have restarted his medication, but there hasn't been much of a response, or it has been forgotten.

They do care but they are also at a point where if they expanded it would allow them to meet the needs that they take. They rarely turn people down which is great, and it would be okay if they communicated there is a longer wait within some range if you choose to use their service, but to say someone will respond in a couple hits and not hear back in a day, or that it will be a few minutes and it's 2 hours just because they are waiting on someone else who wouldn't respond until a certain time, it gets annoying, and is potentially dangerous depending on the situation.

They are reasonably priced, as that may be what also impacts their ability to grow at this point, but it would be great to see them expand services further and likely avoid being in this odd spot of being at or near capacity to where services are impeded. When they are not as busy their services and communication is excellent.

Prior:

Communication seems to be improving between clerical and medical staff. There is a more cohesive experience that only previously happened occasionally. Definitely still some stuff that needs to be updated with the website, but some of the in person signs no longer contract things like phone recordings.

The staff are so friendly and helpful at this location and Dr. Flores and Dr. Castañeda are AMAZING! Both are so sweet and supportive and makes everyone feel welcomed and cared for, and they're also incredibly knowledgeable about cats! I trust them with our precious kitties!!
We bring rescue cats here and have always been pleased with the quality of care and service.

They happily answer any and all questions with honesty and allow you to make the final decision on services instead of forcing them upon you. Every time I take my cats here I never regret it. They saved my cat's life after she swallowed dog aspirin at 9pm!

they did great! and very quick
editing my review because i’ve been going here for a few years now and these people are really the best at what they do. i’ve never had such a caring team take care of my cat and i feel so grateful to them! they have talked on the phone with me for 30 minutes at a time discussing my pet’s health needs. I trust them so much because of the continued high level of communication and love they display. i will always recommend them!

Main skyscraper (highlighted area): This is the famous U.S. Bank Tower, also known as the Library Tower. The building is 310 meters high (73 floors) and is one of the most iconic symbols of the city. It is well known to video game fans as the prototype for the Maze Bank Tower from the cult game GTA V.

This review is long overdue as my dog passed away last year. I have nothing but the best things to say about Dr. Flores and the DTLA team. I had a dog whose medical history was EXTREMELY complex. (To put this in perspective, VCA circulated her case nationally to all of their hospitals.) She had a condition which caused her to have 97% spinal cord compression at the age of 4. After surgery and PT at VCA, she was able to walk again (in her own special way.) However, due to the severe neurologic nature of her injury, she required ongoing specialized care. Dr. Flores was the ONLY vet I met who was comfortable, confident and knowledgeable about my dog’s condition and was with us every step of the way until my dog passed at the age of 16. 16!!! Any other vets that met my dog would be so nervous, and honestly, I don’t blame them. We are beyond grateful for Dr. Flores’ love and care. She is absolutely brilliant and HIGHLY skilled! Thank you for taking such beautiful care of our Lulu, Dr. Flores. Hope you and your wonderful team are doing well! :-) Monika

I just wanted to thank the staff and doc who saw my dog Taz, he was treated so great and they even trimmed his nails without having to sedate him in order to do it; which tells me how much Taz liked them! I cannot thank you all enough for your kindness and knowledge when it came to a very scary situation with my old man! Truly, you guys are amazing! It doesn't go unnoticed!
LOVE this place! Everyone is kind, gentle, and truly caring. They always make my dog feel comfortable and treat him with so much love and attention. I really appreciate the amazing care they provide.
Will call the wrong number on file even after multiple attempts to update. Amateur incompetent front office

Love this vet office. We have taken our large dog for three years now. Dr. Endo is lovely, helpful, encouraging, understanding, and great with our dog. We walked through downtown to arrive, got there much earlier than expected and were still accommodated, welcomed and seen with about a 20-30 min wait. For a regular checkup we were in an out in just about an hour. Haven't had a bad experience with the staff yet and would recommend to others!

Welp last time I was here with you know who, he was maybe 6-7, this was around 2020, so he’s now 12-13 maybe?

He’s been acting strange lately and I thought maybe something was wrong.. turns out hes just fine!

Place was very nice and clean. The doctors were great as always and it was very quick! Recommended!
Had a really good experience here. No surprises, which I appreciated. Would definitely use them again.

This is an amazing jewel in the ❤️ of DTLA. Everyone was so nice and the Vet was so awesome in handling my Penelope Jones 🐶. She had multiple chronic conditions and her Vet got her back on track. I am one grateful 🐾 parent. Girl power 😍 10 star ⭐ rating.

The staff is amazing, the facility is great.
My golden retriever went it with an allergic reaction and they took amazing care of him.

They screwed up the service estimate and acted as if that wasn't solely their mistake. They've changed accounting services a couple of times since then and seem better. We'll see how their record keeping goes.

Great experience at DTLA Vet! Extremely nice lady got us a room and checked on us periodically due to an emergency and the holiday. I was very impressed with the doctor who was not afraid of my dog and very calm—my dog walked off with her. She was thorough, compassionate and had a great sense of humor. I was not forced/scared into paying for anything unnecessary for the illness and worked with my budget. If you want your working breed dog to have a good veterinary experience, I believe this is the best place because I would suppose they’ve seen it all. Excellent experience and he is doing well!!! ☺️ Also, Thanks to the staff in the back I didn’t see!
Incredibly helpful and professional! Highly recommend
Way too pricey for something so little

This is the first vet I took my baby to when arriving to LA. I chose them due to the other reviewers and the cleanliness of their offices. The doctors and some front office staff are very professional with appropriate bedside manner. I’m rating them a 3 because of the differences in the quality of care for clients my skin tone and darker. On several visits depending on who is front desk I either received attentive and quality care or urgent, transactional and disinterested service; sometimes I would call in and be placed on hold almost 10 minutes. I notice however, front desk staff such as Lisa consistently provide quality care to clients regardless of skin color or race, however, the same can not be said about Ava. For a vetinary office with such quality doctors, you would hope the front desk staff provided the same care. Nevertheless, it is important to make other clients aware the disparate treatment darker skinned or minority races may receive as compared to white or latino clients to reduce the likelihood this sort of bias continues. I intend to continue using this clinic and hope this review can incite training and professional development for front office staff in bias, sensitivity, and belonging for all pet parents.
They care about our babies!

The staff are absolutely amazing I have a teacup poodle with a sore ear or neck I was so scared and upset they took him into urgent care and were so gentle and kind . I work in a high profile field and have seen animals and vets world wide and their service is 5/5
My go-to vet. A little high on the price range, but you get excellent quality care for your pets. People here are amazing. Ask for Eder. He's probably the best pet nurse they have.

These folks are so wonderful. We have a group of community cats at our work warehouse in Boyle Heights. We feed them and care for them, as much as we can. (Our food bill from Chewy is over $300). One of our older cats was riddled with a face and mouth infection and his condition had progressed so bad his face was distorted and it was surrounded by insects-it was awful. He's a feral cat so it was difficult to catch him. Once we did catch him, DTLA Vets took him in right away. They treated him with antibiotics, pain meds, flea medicine and really helped him. They were more than happy to help our feral kitty and even offered us a small discount and gratuitous flea meds, and a B-12 shot. We didn't even think he was going live. This facility really cares, they are reasonably priced and help when your animal needs it.

We came here with one of our strays. I have indoor cats and dogs but my son also takes care of every stray that crosses his path . As grandma I oversee their care while he is at work. Well this cat came to us with a hole in his throat. Everyone we called didn’t have time or wanted money up front to just see us. I’m telling you he has a big hole in the middle of his throat I can see his insides and you are  not telling me come over we will take care of him.  You want money just to make an appointment.  This place rushed us in on a packed schedule took care of him and waited to close until he came out of his anesthesia. I picked him up at 10:30 pm!!!  They love their job and treat  every pet in their care as family!!  To say I was amazed is an understatement!!

Last visit we were in and out for my husky’s shots in less than 10 minutes. Our pups are always well taken care of here. And there are free treats to help motivate a nervous pup. The doctors are even great at responding to our questions over email. We moved out of the neighborhood a few years ago but still keep coming back because of their attention to detail, special care and loving treatment

I had a medical emergency for my dog and DTLA Vets was able to take me in right away. Although we ended up needing to transfer to a specialty hospital, Dr. Flores and her team were kind, helpful, and provided the urgent care my dog needed to stabilize her for the trip. Dr. Flores called the specialty hospital beforehand to brief them, so by the time we arrived they could take my dog immediately. DTLA Vets even called the specialty hospital the next morning to check on how my dog was doing. Thank you DTLA Vets for your quick and empathetic care!
Parking is not a great experience but the customer service is great.

I AM SUING THIS PLACE IF YOU CARE ABOUT YOUR PET DO NOT I REPEAT DO NOT BRING YOUR DOG HERE AT ALL!! U WILL REGRET IT!! God pls help me. I swear to god I had a bad feeling when I got here. Very caring staff!

They have refused to provide services to me.  They literally turn me away, I'm not allowed to make an appointment and all they said was over an incident a few years back. What incident? They should at least tell me what they are talking about! I've never been there before and choose to make an appointment since I moved closer to the area.  They got me confused with someone else.  One of my friends had a cat with cancer and couldn't afford the medication about 7 months ago so I called in with my credit card number.  They had NO problem taking my money.

Edit: Pancake died within 36 hours of these photos being taken. His symptoms were severe, and I left DTLAvets because I felt he needed to be seen more quickly. The hospital I took him to admitted him immediately. These pictures were among the last ever taken of him. I will forever wonder what would have happened if the front office staff at DTLAvets had been more knowledgeable and more qualified to diagnose the signs of acute toxicity syndrome.

I do not recommend that you take your pet here for routine care. I do not recommend you take your pet here for emergency care. I do not recommend you take your pet here at all. I will forever think of the front office staff members laughing and talking amongst themselves as my boy was dying, and being completely ignored, and being callous and indifferent when I told them that I could tell that we could not continue to wait any longer.

Sometimes you have to trust your instincts. And my instincts are that the front office folks at DTLAvets will kill your pets with neglect and not think twice about it. And actually blame you for not being willing to wait your turn in line, as the doctor attends to routine cases while your pet is showing signs of neurological impairment.

--------------------------------------------

I recently had a disappointing experience at DTLAvets. Despite having an urgent care appointment for my dog, Pancake, we waited over thirty minutes while his condition worsened. The staff did not acknowledge the urgency of his situation, and the environment seemed to add to his distress.

To make matters worse, another dog in the waiting room was barking at Pancake, increasing his anxiety. When I asked if we could wait elsewhere, the staff refused and did not show any empathy for our situation. They did not make any effort to create a comfortable environment for animals in need of urgent care.

On a positive note, Dr. Coward is a very kind and gentle veterinarian. He has a wonderful demeanor, and Pancake always feels safe with him. I only wish the rest of the staff shared his empathy and compassion.

In the end, I had to take Pancake to another veterinarian who immediately recognized the seriousness of his condition and admitted him to the ICU. Pancake is now receiving treatment for suspected acute toxin exposure, a condition that DTLAvets failed to appropriately triage.

Overall, I am very disappointed with the lack of urgency and care shown by DTLAvets and would not recommend their services for pets in need of immediate attention.
What a fantastic compliment.  Thank you so much, Robb!
